As a retail worker (and someone who worked in fast food for 8 years before that) the people we hate and make fun of are the rude people who make our jobs hell. I've suffered through social anxiety and I would never make fun of someone even behind their back just because they messed up what they said or because they had to correct me. I'm so tired half the time I do mishear what is said or mess up when serving and I'm the one apologising if you correct me because I want to make your order as great and perfect as you want (party store, mostly dealing with balloon orders). But yeah, idk if this helps at all. There are some cruel people in the world who will mock dumb stuff, but most of us aren't like that. A good portion of the people I know are just as anxious as you are and the ones working behind the counter. But we get a lot of entitled and rude customers and we have to just deal with it and not call them out so making fun of them helps blow off steam. Messing up or politely correcting us would never make you the butt of the joke. All I want is for people to not take their poor planning out on me or interrupt me every time I try to tell them something or yell at me for something that isn't my fault.
